title: One descending finite free extension from a finite cone obstruction
statement: Let R be a commutative ring small in the universe v of the R-modules. Let C,F be cochain complexes of R-modules in v, f:F to C a chain map, and b,n integers with n≤b+1. Assume F is zero below n and above b, all its terms are finite free, H^i(Cone(f))=0 for i≥n, and H^(n-1)(Cone(f)) is finite. Cohomology is that of Q of the complex in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then there exist G,g:G to C,j:F to G with G zero below n-1 and above b, all terms finite free, H^i(Cone(g))=0 for i≥n-1, j composed with g equal to f, and j degreewise invertible for i≥n. All complexes and maps remain in universe v.

proof.text: Use homologyFunctorFactors to transport the finite derived homology hypothesis to D.homology(n-1), where D=mappingCone f. Module.Finite.exists_fin' supplies a finite free surjection p:(Fin k→R)→H^(n-1)(D). Construct P=Shrink.{v}(Fin k→R) and compose p with Shrink.linearEquiv to obtain an epimorphism π:P→H^(n-1)(D). Free modules are projective, so Projective.factorThru lifts π through the epimorphism D.homologyπ(n-1) to an actual cycle map q. Projective.factorThru_comp proves q followed by the homology projection is epi. All choices here come from proved Mathlib theorems.

Apply [lem-pc-ring-finite-cone-cycle-attachment] to the constructed P and q, its finite free instances, the proved generating epimorphism, and the unchanged old bounds and cone vanishing hypotheses. This gives G,g,j and all requested properties. The remaining hole is only attachment along supplied cycles, not the finite-generator selection and lifting step.

theorem exists_finiteFree_cone_extension (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Small.{v} R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{v} R)]
    (C F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (f : F ⟶ C) (b n : ℤ)
    (hn : n ≤ b + 1) (hlow : F.IsStrictlyGE n) (hupp : F.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (F.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (F.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ i : ℤ, n ≤ i → IsZero
      ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj (Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone f))))
    (hfinite : Module.Finite R
      ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) (n - 1)).obj
        (Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone f)))) :
    ∃ (G : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (g : G ⟶ C) (j : F ⟶ G),
      G.IsStrictlyGE (n - 1) ∧ G.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (G.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (G.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, n - 1 ≤ i → IsZero
        ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj
          (Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone g)))) ∧
      j ≫ g = f ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, n ≤ i → IsIso (j.f i))
